title: Cowgirl Heaven! 2 Blocks to Broadway! Sleeps 6!
description:
This Cowgirl-themed haven is just two blocks south of Broadway!

This Studio Features:
- Dedicated makeup station with three vanities
- SIX Cozy Beds
- Steps away from Honky Tonks, Bridgestone Arena, and Music City Center
- HEATED POOL
- Fully equipped kitchen
- Super-fast WiFi
- Smart TV
- Bathroom essentials
- In-unit washer and dryer

(Ask us about seasonal DISCOUNTS!)

The space
Sleeping Arrangements:

🛏️ 4 Full Beds (Bunk Beds)
🛏️ 2 Twin beds Trundle Beds)

Community Amenities:
🏊 - Resort-style pool and cabanas
🏋️‍♂️ - Gym with rock climbing wall
🌆 - Sky lounge with panoramic city views
🎯 - Co-working space for productivity
🛎️ - On-site concierge service
👮 - On-site security
🛄 - Baggage drop-off service available

(ADD US TO YOUR WISHLIST <3 )

Location Points of Interest:
🎸- Broadway Honky Tonks - 5-minute walk
🏟️ - Bridgestone Arena - 5-minute walk
🎶 - Music City Center - 2-minute walk
🏈 - Nissan Stadium - 10-minute walk

🎡 - Ascend Amphitheater - 10-minute walk

Guest access
The Burnham utilizes the DOOR App, which requires a smart phone. Further detailed instructions will be provided at the time of booking.

Other things to note
📢 Noise Advisory: During peak hours, there may be increased levels of noise.
🅿️ Parking: Dedicated garage parking is available for $30 per night and must be reserved in advance.
🕒 Early Check-in: Available for $30 per hour (maximum 2 hours), subject to availability.
🕒 Late Check-out: Available for $50 per hour (maximum 2 hours), subject to availability.
🧳 Luggage Service: Paid bellhop service is available in the lobby for luggage drop-off ($5 per item).

Location Disclaimer:

Please be aware that this building is centrally located in downtown Nashville. We do not have control over external factors such as noise, private or public events, or construction that may occur during your stay. Building management oversees pool, gym, and common area access, as well as maintenance of appliances and apartment conditions (plumbing, electrical, HVAC, drywall, etc.). They address any issues according to their protocols. While we strive to provide an exceptional experience, some aspects are beyond our control.

We are dedicated to ensuring your stay is outstanding, focusing on everything within our ability to provide a memorable time in Nashville! Please feel free to contact us with any questions or assistance you may need. Your comfort and satisfaction are our top priorities.
